nodes.norm_label: risk and backward compatibility matrices (additive role field)

nodes.label: learnings.md Predict-Verify Log
nodes.rationale: One entry per new pattern; value is the why-different tradeoff line, written at handoff per docs/ai/handoff.md.

nodes.label: WorkspaceProvider layout cache
nodes.rationale: Layout stays mounted across child navigations so it is the cache; avoids SWR/react-query dependency for one value.

nodes.label: membershipFrom caller-role helper
nodes.rationale: Caller permission on resource X comes from the endpoint serving X (O(1), already authorised), not a paginated list that may not contain it; fails closed.

nodes.label: pdfjs-dist import.meta fails under Jest
nodes.rationale: TS compiles import() to require() under CJS; plain Node loads ESM via require(esm) but Jest's module system cannot. Fixed in test vehicle (CSV branch), not source.

nodes.label: Vision-as-comparator catalog matching
nodes.rationale: Empty catalog page is normal so single-page extraction returns empty list; Promise.all instead of p-limit since candidates capped by CATALOG_MATCH_MAX_CANDIDATES.

nodes.label: mupdf AGPL license decision
nodes.rationale: Check dependency LICENSE before recommending it; AGPL network clause is legal exposure for closed SaaS. Swapped to Apache-2.0 pdfjs-dist + MIT @napi-rs/canvas.

nodes.label: pdfjs-dist + @napi-rs/canvas rasterizer
nodes.rationale: getDocument needs Uint8Array not Buffer; render needs canvas:null alongside canvasContext.

nodes.label: Procurement LLM extraction field validation
nodes.rationale: Non-numeric LLM strings in numeric fields null out individually so one bad row cannot fail a whole bulk insert.

nodes.label: DuckDB sandbox hardening (S1+F1)
nodes.rationale: enable_external_access lock is one-way at engine level; keyword DDL/DML filter still needed; bigint results sanitized to Number.

nodes.label: DuckDB per-CSV type inference bug
nodes.rationale: read_csv_auto infers types per file so BIGINT vs VARCHAR sku broke COALESCE; cast at CTE boundary, not ALL_VARCHAR, because chat path needs numeric inference.

nodes.label: AllExceptionsFilter with requestId
nodes.rationale: Fix observability first: blind 500 became one-line diagnosis.

nodes.label: DuckDB Node ABI install-time pin
nodes.rationale: ABI is install-time only (download URL keyed by node_abi); N-API binding loads under any Node once present.

nodes.label: e2e three stacked causes (timeout, Bull theft, mock)
nodes.rationale: Fix outermost dumbest failure first before A/B testing; BULL_PREFIX per pid isolates queues.
nodes.norm_label: e2e three stacked causes (timeout, bull theft, mock)

nodes.label: BULL_PREFIX queue isolation
nodes.rationale: Default 'bull' keeps production keys byte-identical.

nodes.label: Remove p-limit for in-house createLimit
nodes.rationale: ESM-only dep in CJS package forced an untestable new Function import hack; a workaround its own test runner cannot execute is an untested production path.

nodes.label: Compare integrity row lock (S0a)
nodes.rationale: Transaction gives atomicity, not isolation; SELECT FOR UPDATE on PO row serializes concurrent compares.

nodes.label: Parse failure classification and reconcile (S0b)
nodes.rationale: Retry only world errors, not input errors; fresh jobId on requeue because Bull returns existing job for same id.

nodes.label: TokenMeter and UsageService.metered (S0c)
nodes.rationale: Optional collector keeps chain return shape stable; charge in finally because provider bills the request; 402 is final outcome for processors.

nodes.label: Single-workflow CI gate (S0d)
nodes.rationale: workflow_run executes default-branch copy, so cross-file gating is a race; needs: ci inside one file is the contract.

nodes.label: Production runs Bun not Node
nodes.rationale: oven/bun image symlinks node to bun and spoofs process.version; confirm actual runtime before experimenting. Also xlsx moved to cdn.sheetjs.com URL dep with no lock integrity hash.

nodes.label: Catalog search scoped delete (S0f)
nodes.rationale: Atomic is not correct: delete must scope to open + same matchType + same vendor; raster allowlist avoids stored SVG XSS.

nodes.label: Comparison runs append-only history (S1)
nodes.rationale: Stopping delete preserves dismissals; NULL-run fallback avoided data migration; untested code is not the reference implementation (delta sign).

nodes.label: discrepancy_decisions audit table (S2)
nodes.rationale: Append-only is the absence of update/delete code; avoided first ALTER TYPE by keeping flag status two-state; actor role stored at decision time.

nodes.label: Source evidence download (S4)
nodes.rationale: Pick precedent by threat: KB download (octet-stream, attachment, nosniff) not getItemPhoto inline; filename sanitizer deduped into one module.

nodes.label: Line item provenance columns (S3a)
nodes.rationale: source_page dropped because unfillable; source_row needs skipEmptyLines off; uom aliases exclude units.

nodes.label: Header linkage and currency normalization (S3b)
nodes.rationale: IsISO4217CurrencyCode is case-insensitive so normalize in service; a check accepts more than assumed and the surplus lands in the DB.

nodes.label: assertUnreachable exhaustiveness for goods receipt (S5)
nodes.rationale: Guard secures discriminated sites only; reconcile and per-kind routes express kind by repetition so compiler is silent; grep table names.

nodes.label: Three-way comparison PO/GRN/invoice (S6)
nodes.rationale: Empty Papa.unparse([]) wrote headerless CSV breaking every comparison; a new optional source is not optional to the query that names it.

nodes.label: uom_mismatch and currency needs-review flags
nodes.rationale: Absent is not a value (NULL qty/unit/currency never read as zero or different); engine run over demo seed exposed seed disagreeing with engine.

nodes.label: Pagination needs a unique sort key (S7)
nodes.rationale: created_at shared inside one transaction so ordering by it alone repeats/drops rows across pages; end orderBy with desc(id).
nodes.norm_label: pagination needs a unique sort key (s7)

nodes.label: Decision routes with no callers (S7 commit 2)
nodes.rationale: Client functions had zero callers and RolesGuard never ran in e2e; approved plan is a hypothesis, not specification; PO Select lists must not be paginated.
nodes.norm_label: decision routes with no callers (s7 commit 2)

nodes.label: Goods receipt status filter (S8 c1)
nodes.rationale: Failed parse left stale low quantities producing false short_receipt accusations; automation is a magnifier not a cause.

nodes.label: Auto-compare job id and freshness skip (S8 c2)
nodes.rationale: Idempotency key must identify the input not the intention: compare started_at, include strategy_version and receipts, id carries newest input updated_at.
nodes.norm_label: auto-compare job id and freshness skip (s8 c2)

nodes.label: Hard-coded enum lists and silent fallbacks (S8 c3)
nodes.rationale: Derive from workspaceEventTypeEnum.enumValues; ?? type and default: turn forgetting into silently wrong product; comparison_flagged name chosen because enum values are one-way.
nodes.norm_label: hard-coded enum lists and silent fallbacks (s8 c3)

nodes.label: Branch selects label not recorded evidence (S9 c1)
nodes.rationale: toFlagValues read price columns only on price_mismatch so quantity+price lines lost the price; ranking is presentation, persistence is evidence.
nodes.norm_label: branch selects label not recorded evidence (s9 c1)

nodes.label: drizzle-kit drops partial index where clause (S9 c2)
nodes.rationale: Builder accepts .where() but generator emits a plain unique index, meaning the opposite; read emitted SQL; invariant moved into VendorPriceTermsService.create as sole writer.
nodes.norm_label: drizzle-kit drops partial index where clause (s9 c2)

nodes.label: Contract price finding outside the CASE (S9 c5)
nodes.rationale: First-match CASE is a classifier valid only for mutually exclusive classes; independent finding computed in TypeScript over PO lines; own contract_unit_price column.
nodes.norm_label: contract price finding outside the case (s9 c5)

nodes.label: Vendor history refuses to average (S9 c7-8)
nodes.rationale: POLICY v1 #4/#6: units and currency not converted so avg is a guess; count is safe; exceptionSummary returns zeroes; agreedPriceAt duplication accepted as a bet.
nodes.norm_label: vendor history refuses to average (s9 c7-8)

nodes.label: AI workflow port (TDD guard, gate, persona generator)
nodes.rationale: Symlinked node_modules would test head code in base worktree and fake RED; bunx silently downloads missing binaries.
nodes.norm_label: ai workflow port (tdd guard, gate, persona generator)

nodes.label: B22 backups, B2, compose environment override
nodes.rationale: environment: beats env_file: so pinned S3_ENDPOINT overrode B2; B2 Write Only still allows deleteFiles; endpoint now ${S3_ENDPOINT:?}.
nodes.norm_label: b22 backups, b2, compose environment override

nodes.label: Three test layers (unit, API e2e, Playwright)
nodes.rationale: MulterError filters never fired because FileInterceptor converts to PayloadTooLargeException; unit test passed with a raw MulterError the real pipeline never produces; enforced by scripts/check-test-layers.sh.
nodes.norm_label: three test layers (unit, api e2e, playwright)

nodes.label: Count-first account lockout concurrency
nodes.rationale: Read-then-write limits only hold for sequential requests; count attempt first via Redis INCR or single UPDATE with row lock.

nodes.label: Graphify completer content-hash cache lookup
nodes.rationale: A content-keyed cache is only fresh for the key you ask with; resolve by live file_hash across namespaces in scripts/graphify-complete.py.

nodes.label: Disabling Mnemra-era support surfaces
nodes.rationale: notFound() in layout.tsx keeps status 200 behind root loading.tsx; hard 404 needs middleware; page tests reach across areas.

nodes.label: One process one copy of pdfjs (loadPdfjs)
nodes.rationale: Two copies fight over globalThis.pdfjsWorker; destroy via loading task.
nodes.norm_label: one process one copy of pdfjs (loadpdfjs)

nodes.label: Launch hardening slices S1-S4 and fixes B1-B18
nodes.rationale: Characterization suites refuse to assert known bugs; each fix red-then-green with three-run stability.
nodes.norm_label: launch hardening slices s1-s4 and fixes b1-b18

nodes.label: ParseUUIDPipe route-metadata sweep (B13/B16)
nodes.rationale: Path params skip global ValidationPipe; one codebase-walking test stops the next route forgetting.

nodes.label: Settle each paid call (B6/B15)
nodes.rationale: Promise.all discards every result already bought on one rejection.

nodes.label: Exact decimal delta (B9)
nodes.rationale: Doubles cannot hold decimals; BigInt-scaled subtraction; 1e400 read as Infinity becomes null delta.

nodes.label: Upload filename latin1/UTF-8 and RFC 5987 (B8)
nodes.rationale: Fixing encoding inbound moves problem outbound: Node rejects header chars above U+00FF; backfill SQL parity-tested against decodeUploadFilename.

nodes.label: Error state vs empty state (B14/B18)
nodes.rationale: Failed load rendered as empty tells a falsehood; build shared component in first fix so rest is cheap.

nodes.label: Design handoff 1:1 reproduction contract (C-1/C-3)
nodes.rationale: Lock primitive contract from consuming screens, not primitive sheet; twelve amendments were needed.

nodes.label: Marketing numbers recomputed in tests
nodes.rationale: A public number is a claim; derive from adjacent data (L03 18% corrected to 21.4%).

nodes.label: Onboarding tour first-run overlay fixture
nodes.rationale: Seed optra.tour.v1:<userId> in auth.setup.ts storage state; resolveTourTheme reads tokens from computed style since SVG attrs cannot take var().

nodes.label: ReactBits/shadcn vendored components
nodes.rationale: Vendored files miss default React import and 'use client'; Vitest cannot catch RSC boundary bugs, only next build static generation; ScrollReveal hardcodes h2 so dropped.

nodes.label: Dead dark: variant path in Badge
nodes.rationale: Tailwind dark: follows OS media query while app tokens sit behind an unused .dark class.
nodes.norm_label: dead dark: variant path in badge

nodes.label: Full QA sweep: ogl crash and tree-kill procps
nodes.rationale: ogl Renderer null-context crash guarded by try/catch in Strands.tsx; nest --watch tree-kill needs procps in Debian slim; Mnemra branding leftovers in 6 files.
nodes.norm_label: full qa sweep: ogl crash and tree-kill procps

nodes.label: Router Cache stale login redirect fix
nodes.rationale: Prefetch of /chat while logged out cached middleware redirect; router.refresh() before push.
nodes.norm_label: router cache stale login redirect fix

nodes.label: apiFetch retry-on-401 self-contained refresh
nodes.rationale: client.ts inlines refresh fetch to avoid circular import with auth.ts.

nodes.label: V2 slices F3-F7a (freshness, FAQ, comparison, digest, coverage)
nodes.rationale: Embedding-distance freshness over LLM compare; FaqClusterService reused; Redis read-model for coverage; per-channel try/catch digest; verify .env instead of trusting plan doc.
nodes.norm_label: v2 slices f3-f7a (freshness, faq, comparison, digest, coverage)

nodes.label: chat_query_metrics telemetry (S3)
nodes.rationale: await write().catch not fire-and-forget to avoid race; nullable embeddings to skip cost on cache hits.

nodes.label: Phase 2 UI primitives and procurement/catalog-matches pages
nodes.rationale: ImageTile ref forwarded to wrapper div since Skeleton is not forwardRef; loadPage/refreshDocs split avoids poll skeleton flashes.
nodes.norm_label: phase 2 ui primitives and procurement/catalog-matches pages
